name: affiliate-link-validation
description: §18.4 Affiliate Link Validation: HTTP reachability check with timeout; broken → NEEDS_REVIEW. Terms/approval never assumed (§4).

nodes.name: http-check-link
nodes.notes: Reachability check for the affiliate URL (§4: detect broken links). Validates reachability only — commission terms/eligibility must be confirmed on the network dashboard (never assumed, §4).

nodes.name: classify-link
nodes.notes: Classifies 2xx/3xx as reachable; timeouts/DNS/4xx/5xx as broken. NOTE: item shape differs on http error — handled defensively.

nodes.name: mark-broken
nodes.notes: Broken links → NEEDS_REVIEW (§4). Never publishes with a dead link.
